replay_logs: replay a list of agent action logs in a simulation environment by invoking each recorded action
find_log_position: find the index of a specific log entry by its ID in a list of world logs
find_previous_step_position: find the index of the previous StepLog entry before a given position in world logs
review_replay_logs: review the replay_logs function to understand how it re-enacts recorded agent actions in an environment
summarize_find_log_position: summarize the find_log_position function that searches world logs by log ID with optional type filtering
